name: Google Chrome
notes: Enterprise MSI. Google Update remains enabled; catalog approval applies to the packaged release. The mutable MSI URL must be rechecked against the candidate version in the isolated verifier.

name: Mozilla Firefox ESR
notes: Use the ESR channel and the en-US machine MSI. Firefox's own update mechanism remains enabled.

name: Adobe Acrobat Reader
notes: Adobe's enterprise download service reports the current Reader version. Discovery selects only the matching full x64 en-US installer on Adobe's distribution host and confirms it exists, never an MSP patch. Each tenant accepts Adobe's distribution agreement before deployment. Adobe ARM remains enabled.

licenceAttestation.title: Adobe Acrobat Reader Distribution License Agreement

name: 7-Zip
unsignedExceptionReason: Igor Pavlov publishes 7-Zip installers without Authenticode signatures. Releases come only from the publisher's official GitHub repository, are pinned to the GitHub asset SHA256, and must pass a clean Defender scan and the full lifecycle test.
notes: Publisher-linked official GitHub releases. Unsigned binaries are accepted only under the reviewed exception above, with an exact hash and clean malware evidence.

name: Notepad++
notes: Review the exact current signing identity before first approval. Signing identity changes require a definition review. The vendor updater remains enabled.

name: Visual Studio Code
notes: System installer only. The user installer is outside this pilot's machine deployment profile. VS Code's updater remains enabled.

name: Git for Windows
notes: Review the publisher certificate identity and default installation choices before approval.

name: VLC media player
notes: Starts from the official archive. VideoLAN may redirect the download to any HTTPS mirror; that is accepted automatically because discovery pins the publisher SHA256 from the .sha256 file beside the installer and every download must match it. The application's update notifications remain enabled.

name: WinSCP
notes: Publisher-linked SourceForge project and all-users setup. The setup is a 32-bit (x86) installer that installs to Program Files (x86); the stable release has no x64 build. Discovery pins the publisher SHA256 from the official release ReadMe on winscp.net. Verify final redirect provenance, signature, and hash in the isolated verifier. Update notifications remain enabled.

name: PuTTY
notes: Publisher-linked versioned x64 MSI; standalone executables and development snapshots are excluded.

name: Mozilla Firefox
notes: Stable Release channel, x64 en-US publisher MSI. Independent from ESR. Use a prior publisher release for upgrade QA; vendor updater remains enabled.

name: Zoom Workplace
notes: Publisher x64 enterprise MSI, all users. Publisher four-part download build maps to the MSI three-part ProductVersion (major.minor.build). MSI automatic update defaults stay disabled. The reviewed initial upgrade baseline is used only before an approved release exists.

name: Audacity
notes: Publisher x86_64 MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. The publisher appends an MSI build number to its three-part public release; QA compares the reviewed release components and binds the exact build by hash. ARM and optional FFmpeg/AI payloads are separate; use a previous MSI release for upgrade QA.

name: PowerShell 7
notes: Explicit 7.6 LTS channel, x64 machine MSI, publisher asset SHA-256. Microsoft Update opt-in is disabled by installer properties; existing administrator update policy may override it. Never switch to the 7.7 MSIX distribution; updating the major/minor channel requires a reviewed definition.

name: AWS Command Line Interface v2
notes: Publisher versioned x64 all-users MSI. Discover v2 releases from the official repository tags, measure SHA-256 in the isolated VM, and require an earlier official version for upgrade QA.

name: TeamViewer
notes: Publisher full x64 client, not QuickSupport, Host, or the licensed custom MSI. The publisher URL is mutable; the VM must verify the advertised installed version and measure the exact SHA-256. The vendor updater remains enabled. Commercial use requires the organization's TeamViewer licence; no account assignment or remote access configuration is included.

name: Python 3.14
notes: Fixed 3.14 channel, publisher x64 offline EXE; exclude prereleases, install manager, embeddable ZIPs, ARM and x86. Machine install with pip and PATH; omit the separate shared launcher. CPython's Windows ARP version uses patch*1000+150 for final releases, which QA must compare exactly. Upgrade QA uses an earlier 3.14 installer.

name: WinRAR
notes: Publisher stable English x64 EXE; beta and localized filenames are excluded. The 7.22 publisher installer is the initial upgrade baseline. WinRAR is evaluation software; the deploying organization supplies its own licence. No licence key is bundled.

name: Node.js LTS
notes: Fixed major-24 LTS channel, publisher machine x64 MSI with npm and publisher SHA256SUMS. Current, older LTS majors and non-MSI payloads are excluded. Optional native-build tools are not enabled. An earlier major-24 MSI is required for upgrade QA.

name: Wireshark
notes: Fixed 4.6 stable channel, publisher machine x64 MSI, hash pinned by the publisher SIGNATURES file. The approved publisher URL may redirect to HTTPS mirrors only with that hash pin. Npcap and USBPcap are separate products and are not installed, upgraded or removed by this package. The reviewed 4.6.8 MSI is the initial upgrade baseline when the download page lists only the current stable release.

name: LibreOffice
notes: Newest release in the publisher stable directory, x64 machine MSI. The publisher download host redirects to HTTPS mirrors, so discovery pins the SHA256 from the .sha256 file beside the installer. The MSI appends a build number to the three-part public release; QA compares three components and binds the exact build by hash. The earlier stable release listed by the publisher is used for upgrade QA.

name: Mozilla Thunderbird
notes: Stable release channel, x64 en-US publisher MSI with publisher SHA256SUMS. Removal uses the Mozilla helper /S contract shared with Firefox. The previous major release is used for upgrade QA; the vendor updater remains enabled.

name: Go
notes: Publisher x64 machine MSI from the go.dev release index, which also supplies the publisher SHA256. The newest stable release of the previous supported minor version is used for upgrade QA.

name: CMake
notes: Publisher x86_64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. Release candidates are excluded. PATH is left at the installer default.

name: GitHub CLI
notes: Publisher amd64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256.

name: Azure CLI
notes: Publisher x64 machine MSI from the official GitHub release, with asset SHA-256. The 32-bit MSI is excluded. The bundled x64 Python runtime is the installed executable checked by QA.

name: LLVM
notes: Publisher win64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. Release candidates and Windows on ARM builds are excluded.

name: Neovim
notes: Publisher win64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. The moving "stable" and nightly tags are never versions, so only numbered releases qualify.

name: VSCodium
notes: System x64 setup only; the user setup and MSI variants are excluded. GitHub asset SHA-256. The application updater remains enabled.

name: DBeaver Community
notes: Publisher x86_64 setup with GitHub asset SHA-256 and the documented all-users switch. The bundled Java runtime is part of the package. The current-user registration is a different product and is never matched.

name: MongoDB Compass
notes: Full edition x64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256; the isolated and read-only editions and beta releases are excluded. The application updater remains enabled.

name: Microsoft Azure Storage Explorer
notes: Publisher x64 setup with GitHub asset SHA-256, installed for all users. The application updater remains enabled.

name: KeePassXC
notes: Publisher Win64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. The LegacyWindows build is excluded.

name: Nextcloud Desktop
notes: Publisher x64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. The MSI appends a build date to the three-part public release; QA compares three components and binds the exact build by hash. Restart is suppressed. The client updater remains enabled.

name: Mattermost Desktop
notes: Publisher x64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. No server URL is preconfigured. The application updater remains enabled.

name: RustDesk
notes: Publisher x86_64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256; nightly builds are excluded. The MSI appends a build number to the three-part public release; QA compares three components and binds the exact build by hash. No relay server or permanent password is preconfigured.

name: OBS Studio
notes: Publisher x64 setup with GitHub asset SHA-256; betas and release candidates are excluded. The application updater remains enabled.

name: MuseScore Studio
notes: Publisher x86_64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. The MSI appends a build number to the three-part public release; QA compares three components and binds the exact build by hash. Muse Hub and sound libraries are separate products.

name: calibre
notes: Publisher 64-bit machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256; the portable installer is excluded. The publisher removes installers from older GitHub releases, so the reviewed 9.14.0 MSI on the publisher download host is the initial upgrade baseline, hash measured in the isolated VM.

name: PDFsam Basic
notes: Publisher x64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. The thank-you web page after installation is suppressed.

name: Flameshot
notes: Publisher win64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256.

name: ShareX
notes: Publisher x64 setup with GitHub asset SHA-256. The application is not started after installation.

name: WinDirStat
notes: Publisher x64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256. The publisher tags releases as release/vX.Y.Z.

name: WinMerge
notes: Publisher x64 all-users setup with GitHub asset SHA-256; the per-user, x86 and ARM64 setups are excluded.

name: PeaZip
notes: Publisher WIN64 setup with GitHub asset SHA-256; the 32-bit setup and portable archives are excluded.

name: qBittorrent
notes: Publisher x64 setup from the official GitHub release with asset SHA-256; the libtorrent 2.0 variant is excluded. SourceForge mirrors are never used.

name: Transmission
notes: Publisher Qt 6 x64 machine MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256; the Qt 5 and x86 builds are excluded.

name: ImageGlass
notes: Publisher x64 MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256, installed for all users; the Pro and Business editions and MSIX packages are excluded.

name: Arduino IDE
notes: Publisher 64-bit MSI with GitHub asset SHA-256, installed for all users. Board drivers are installed by the IDE on demand and are not part of this package.

name: DB Browser for SQLite

executablePaths: DB Browser for SQLite/DB Browser for SQLite.exe
